_comment: WorkspaceEdit in the `documentChanges` form (LSP 3.13+): an array of {textDocument: {uri, version}, edits: [...]} instead of the {uri: TextEdit[]} `changes` map. rust-analyzer and gopls prefer this form, and per spec a server may only use the form the client advertised — so we declare workspace.workspaceEdit.documentChanges and parse it. The URI hangs off a nested textDocument rather than being a map key, which the position remapper resolves and the parse reads. `resourceOperations` stays unadvertised; gaps_resource_operations.json covers what happens when one arrives anyway.
